question: Which of the following sportspersons won a silver medal at the 2012 London Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sushil Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sushil Kumar won a silver medal at the 2012 London Olympics**__.

 __
 
• **Sushil Kumar** had a tough draw at the 2012 Summer Games but won silver to become India’s only individual two-time Olympic medallist.
 
• Sushil Kumar is a former Indian wrestler.
 
• He carried the Indian flag at the opening ceremony of the** 2012 London Olympics**.
 
• His 2008 Olympic medal was second for India in wrestling and the first since Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav's bronze medal at the 1952 Summer Olympics.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saina Nehwal** is an Indian professional badminton player and politician belonging to Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• **Gagan Narang** is an Indian sports shooter, supported by the Olympic Gold Quest.
 
 
• He won the bronze medal in the Men's 10 m Air Rifle Event at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London with a final score of 701.1 on 30 July 2012.
 
 
 
• **Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom** OLY is an Indian amateur boxer, politician, and incumbent Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha.
